items.title: Co-efficient of Performance of Refrigerator (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Co-efficient of Performance of Refrigerator: a main subheading of 6.9 Refrigerator, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 132-133.

blocks.text: LTR se nikali gayi heat (Q_C) aur kiye gaye work (W) ka ratio (nisbat) refrigerator ka co-efficient of performance kehlata hai.
Achha refrigerator kam mechanical work ya electrical (bijli ki) energy kharch kar ke andar se zyada heat nikalta hai. Refrigerator ka co-efficient of performance:
Temperature ki shakal mein, kyun ke Q ∝ T, co-efficient of performance yeh hai (yahan T₁ thande reservoir ka aur T₂ garam reservoir ka temperature hai):

blocks.title: Example 6.4
blocks.problem: Ek refrigerator ka co-efficient of performance 8 hai. Freezer ka temperature −23 °C ho to woh kis temperature par heat bahar phenkta hai?
steps: Thande reservoir (freezer) ka temperature T₁ = −23 °C = −23 + 273 = 250 K
Garam reservoir (kamra) ka temperature T₂ = ? (yahi nikalna hai)
blocks.answer: Refrigerator 281.25 K, yani 8.25 °C, par heat bahar phenkta hai.

blocks.caption: Heat engine aur refrigerator ka muqabla
rows: garam reservoir se thande reservoir ki taraf
thande hisse se garam surroundings ki taraf
system karta hai, W = Q₁ − Q₂
system par hota hai, W = Q_H − Q_C

blocks.prompt: Ek refrigerator har cycle mein andar se 1200 J nikalta hai aur surroundings ko 1800 J deta hai. Work kitna laga aur co-efficient of performance kya hai? Kya refrigerator heat ko thande se garam ki taraf le ja kar doosra law torta hai?
blocks.explanation: W = Q_H − Q_C = 1800 J − 1200 J = 600 J; E = Q_C/W = 1200/600 = 2. Nahi: Clausius ka bayan sirf yeh kehta hai ke heat khud ba khud thande se garam ki taraf nahi jati. Refrigerator yeh kaam bahar se work le kar karta hai, aur system aur surroundings ki kul entropy phir bhi barhti hai.

items: Refrigerator ulta heat engine hai (Clausius): thande hisse se Q_C leta hai, us par W kiya jata hai, surroundings ko Q_H = Q_C + W deta hai.
Co-efficient of performance E = Q_C/W = Q_C/(Q_H − Q_C) = T₁/(T₂ − T₁) (T₁ thanda, T₂ garam). Example 6.4: T₂ = 281.25 K = 8.25 °C.
